description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationSync plugin/component, utilizing Google Test and Google Mock frameworks to verify its behavior in different scenarios such as initialization, location change events, configuration validation, and error handling.

classes.name: SystemInfoMock
classes.description: Mock class for SystemInfo, provides a MOCK_METHOD for the Set method to emulate system info updates.

classes.name: LocationSyncTest
classes.description: Test fixture class setting up the environment to run various tests on the LocationSync plugin, including mock dependencies, event handling, and response verification.

methods.name: activate_locationchange_location_deactivate
methods.description: Test case that verifies the activation of location change subscription, receipt of location update event, and proper deactivation.

methods.name: activate_sync_deactivate
methods.description: Test case confirming that synchronization can be activated and deactivated correctly.

methods.name: activateWithIncorrectUrl
methods.description: Test case that initializes the plugin with an invalid URL and asserts the correct error message.

methods.name: activateWithUnreachableHost_location_deactivate
methods.description: Test case that checks plugin behavior when configured with an unreachable host, ensuring it handles location and internet subsystems appropriately.
